scope: Local API validation for expanded screen annotations; not a production deployment or native overlay verification.

unit.externalServices: Firebase Admin and LiveKit SDK mocked; no live SFU claim from these tests.

integration.countNote: 14 scenario subtests plus their parent test, as reported by node:test.
integration.annotationCoverage: 403 for nonmember; 400 for malformed geometry, size overflow, oversized text, forged identity and empty erase targets. Live annotation rendering and publishing remain separate frontend/media QA.

checks: Coordinates finite and normalized; shape geometry nonempty
Erase affects only matching IDs on the authorized screen; repeated erase is a no-op
Only screen owner, host or moderator may annotate
Membership, room status and role rechecked within transaction
Bounded40-item state; clear preserves other screens
Socket event emitted after state transaction returns

notes: No migration or schema change; bounded annotation JSON state in existing Room field
No new external endpoint or network destination; existing LiveKit screen verification retained
Existing Firebase bearer authentication and room authorization retained
No native companion protocol, CSRF or desktop integration changes in this API scope

notCovered: Production Render deployment of these changes
Frontend tool rendering and cross-participant shape/erase behavior; assigned to separate media QA
